Hi Elena — welcome aboard, and thanks for the proactive note.

Checklist of what we need to validate and clear invoice #5581:  (please send as PDF attachments where possible)
1) Completed W-8BEN-E, signed by an authorized signatory (PDF).
2) Beneficial owner declaration (signed).
3) Government-issued company registration (certificate of incorporation) showing legal name and jurisdiction.
4) Photo ID of signatory (passport or national ID) + title on the signatory page.
5) Optional but helpful: a short signatory letter (one paragraph) on company letterhead confirming signatory authority.

Answers to your two questions:
- Notarization: Not required in most cases — we accept a digitally-signed PDF. If the W-8BEN-E has an in-country requirement (customer's internal policy) we can accept notarized copies, but not mandatory for Redwood AP.
- 1099 issuance: If HelixPath provides a valid W-8BEN-E (foreign entity) we do NOT issue a Form 1099. Instead, we retain the W-8BEN-E on file. If you are a US-person entity or have a US taxable presence, we'd need a W-9 and an EIN for 1099 processing.

Couple of process notes: after we receive the docs our finance team (Marcus) will verify name/EIN or foreign tax ID and mark the vendor profile. Once verified, we'll release the payment per NET30. If anything looks inconsistent we'll follow up with a short list of outstanding items.

If you prefer, you can send everything through DocuSign and include the envelope link; that speeds verification.

I'll loop Marcus and Kimberly for verification.

Best,

Hi Elena / Soojin — thanks for the fast turnaround and for sending the DocuSign link. I reviewed the W-8BEN-E and supporting documents. A few quick notes and the final verification steps: 

1) 1099: Confirmed — because HelixPath is a non-US entity and has provided a valid, completed W-8BEN-E, Redwood will NOT issue a Form 1099 for payments to HelixPath. The W-8BEN-E will be retained in our vendor file.

2) EIN: Not required — a US EIN is only necessary if you are a US entity or have a US taxable presence. For foreign payees with a valid W-8BEN-E, we do not require a US EIN to release payment. Your foreign tax ID (if present) is useful but not mandatory for release.

3) Notarization / apostille: Not required for Redwood. The DocuSign-signed PDF plus photo ID and certificate of incorporation are sufficient for our audit trail.

Outstanding (minor) items: 
- The signatory title on the passport scan should match the signatory letter / DocuSign; Maria Gonzalez's passport scan shows her name but not the CFO title — could you either attach a short signatory letter on letterhead confirming her role, or resend a passport page that includes the title (if available)?

Once we receive the one-line signatory letter we will complete verification and mark invoice #5581 as ready for payment. Expected release: same-day upon verification; otherwise within 24 hours of receiving the signatory letter.

For our records I am adding HubSpot ID HS-4927 to the vendor record.
